# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
In the left margin of the inspection record off to the side, write "Dir Log #_" followed by the next available number in the sequence for the district that this inspection was conducted in; for instance Laco Dir Log #10.
3. Print the field test results directly on the inspection form.
4. In the REMARKS section at the bottom of the inspection record, include the message I-TD (unsatisfactory or out-of-compliance).
5. PURSUANT TO SECTION 7 OF THE LICENSE AGENTS, IF AN UNPOTABLE MUNICIPAL WATER SAMPLE IS ENTERED INTO THE FIELD LAB REPORTING/GENIS SYSTEM, YOU MUST PRINT OUT THE ORIGINAL FIELD REPORT FORM WITH THE UNPOTABLE TEST RESULT, INCLUDE THE REMARKS (I-TD) ON THE FORM, AND THEN IMMEDIATELY NOTIFY THE APPLICANT, CONSUMER, OR OTHER INDIVIDUAL WHO REQUESTED THE WATER TESTING THAT
